feature: GUI Wrapper with Drag-and-Drop for PNG to ICO Converter
workflow_rationale: This is a feature addition that creates new GUI functionality without modifying existing CLI behavior. The task involves creating new code that integrates with existing conversion logic from ico_converter.py. Since it's a single-service desktop application, the workflow is straightforward with sequential implementation phases.
